alt_matches.instructions: state has one image from a web page, its alt text and the heading and text of the section that holds the image. Does the alt text describe what the image actually shows, so that a person who cannot see the image would know its content? An alt text that only repeats a keyword or the page title, or names something the image does not show, does not describe the image.

fits_section.instructions: Does the image show something that belongs to the topic of the section, such as a screenshot, chart, diagram, example or photo of the thing the section explains? A generic stock photo, a decorative picture or an image about another topic does not fit.
